usageNotes: Permanently removes a user account from the Proxmox authentication realm. The caller must hold both `Realm.AllocateUser` on the target realm and `User.Modify` on any group the user belongs to — both checks must pass. Built-in accounts (e.g., `root@pam`) cannot be deleted.

examples.summary: Delete a local PAM user named jsmith

destructiveReason: Immediately and permanently deletes the user account; all associated API tokens are also removed and any active sessions for that user will lose access.
tips: The `userid` must be in `name@realm` format (e.g., `alice@pve`, `bob@pam`) — bare usernames are rejected.
Deleting a user does not remove files, VMs, or permissions assigned to that user ID; revoke or reassign those first.
API tokens belonging to the deleted user are also destroyed — ensure no automation depends on them before proceeding.
To temporarily disable access without deleting, use update_access_users_userid (PUT) and set `enable=0` instead.
